definitions.text_mt: Minn issa 'l quddiem; fil-ġejjieni.
Għal dak li għandu jseħħ fil-futur.

usage_examples.mt: Għalliġej, irridu nkunu iżjed attenti.
usage_examples.en: Henceforth, we must be more careful.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nafux x'jistenniena għalliġej.
usage_examples.en: We do not know what awaits us in the future.

definitions.text_mt: Biċċa art miftuħa u kkultivata, tipikament imħawla bil-ħxejjex jew użata għar-ragħa tal-bhejjem.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi ħarat l-għalqa qabel ma żeraż-żerriegħa.
usage_examples.en: The farmer ploughed the field before sowing the seed.

usage_examples.mt: L-għelieqi ta' madwar ir-raħel huma kollhom ħodor fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The fields around the village are all green in spring.

definitions.text_mt: Kitba oħra ta' għelt; żball jew nuqqas.

usage_examples.mt: Kien għalt li ma widenx il-parir tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: It was a mistake not to listen to his advice.

usage_examples.mt: Għamilt għalt meta ħsibt li kien se jgħinni.
usage_examples.en: I made an error when I thought he would help me.

definitions.text_mt: Għal ebda raġuni; mingħajr skop jew bżonn.

usage_examples.mt: Għalxejn tipprova tgħidlu xi ħaġa għax ma jismax.
usage_examples.en: There is no point trying to tell him anything because he does not listen.

usage_examples.mt: Ġejt għalxejn għax il-ħanut kien magħluq.
usage_examples.en: I came for nothing because the shop was closed.

definitions.text_mt: Kitba oħra ta' għaliex; ir-raġuni jew il-kawża ta' xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nafx għalxiex għamilt hekk.
usage_examples.en: I do not know why you did that.

usage_examples.mt: Għalxiex tħossok hekk wara kull ma għamel għalik?
usage_examples.en: Why do you feel that way after all he did for you?

definitions.text_mt: Kitba oħra ta' għaliex; ir-raġuni jew il-kawża wara xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Qatt ma spjega l-għalxiex ta' għemilu.
usage_examples.en: He never explained the reason for his action.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi nkun naf l-għalxiex qabel ma niddeċiedi.
usage_examples.en: I need to know the reason before I decide.

definitions.text_mt: Perjodu ta' tnax-il xahar li fih id-dinja ddur madwar ix-xemx; sena.

usage_examples.mt: Għadu kif għalaq għam minn meta miet missieru.
usage_examples.en: It has just been a year since his father died.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna għam li ma rajniex.
usage_examples.en: It has been a year since we saw him.

definitions.text_mt: Jiċċaqlaq fl-ilma billi jċaqlaq idejh u riġlejh.
Jibqa' fuq il-wiċċ ta' likwidu mingħajr ma jegħreq.

usage_examples.mt: Tajjeb li tgħallem tgħum meta tkun żgħir.
usage_examples.en: It is good to learn to swim when you are young.

usage_examples.mt: L-injam jgħum fuq l-ilma.
usage_examples.en: Wood floats on water.

definitions.text_mt: Kitba ħażina ta' agħma; min ma jistax jara.

usage_examples.mt: Din hija kitba ħażina; il-kelma t-tajba hi agħma.
usage_examples.en: This is a misspelling; the correct word is agħma.

definitions.text_mt: In-nuqqas tal-kapaċità li tara; nuqqas tal-vista.

usage_examples.mt: L-għama tista' tkun ikkawżata minn diversi mard.
usage_examples.en: Blindness can be caused by various diseases.

usage_examples.mt: Tilef għajnejh f'inċident u għex bl-għama għall-bqija ta' ħajtu.
usage_examples.en: He lost his eyes in an accident and lived with blindness for the rest of his life.

definitions.text_en: to blind, to make someone blind
definitions.text_mt: Iċaħħad lil xi ħadd mill-kapaċità li jara; iġiegħel lil xi ħadd isir agħma.

usage_examples.mt: Id-dija qawwija tax-xemx għamitu għal ftit sekondi.
usage_examples.en: The bright sunlight blinded him for a few seconds.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rabja tgħama l-ġudizzju tiegħu u ma setax jaħseb sewwa.
usage_examples.en: Anger blinded his judgment and he could not think clearly.

definitions.text_en: blindfold (a covering, usually a bandage, for the eyes)
definitions.text_mt: Faxxa jew għatu li jitqiegħed fuq l-għajnejn biex ma jara xejn.
Tagħmir imqiegħed ma' ġenb l-għajnejn taż-żiemel biex ma jara minn ġenb.

usage_examples.mt: Poġġewlu l-għamad fuq għajnejh qabel ma ħaduh.
usage_examples.en: They put a blindfold over his eyes before taking him.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żiemel kellu l-għamad biex ma jibżax mill-istorbju ta' madwaru.
usage_examples.en: The horse had blinkers so it would not get frightened by the noise around it.

definitions.text_mt: Il-post fejn wieħed jgħix; residenza jew dar.
Iż-żmien tal-ħajja meta wieħed jilħaq il-maturità u s-saħħa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: L-għamar tiegħu kien villa sabiħa fil-kampanja.
usage_examples.en: His dwelling was a beautiful villa in the countryside.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal fl-għamar tal-ħajja meta beda jieħu deċiżjonijiet għaqlin.
usage_examples.en: He reached the time of maturity when he started making wise decisions.

definitions.text_mt: Jgħix f'xi post b'mod permanenti; jirrisjedi.

usage_examples.mt: Għamar f'dik id-dar għal ħamsa u tletin sena.
usage_examples.en: He lived in that house for thirty-five years.

usage_examples.mt: Il-poplu għamar f'dawk l-artijiet għal sekli sħaħ.
usage_examples.en: The people inhabited those lands for centuries.

definitions.text_mt: L-oġġetti kbar u ż-żgħar li jintużaw f'dar bħall-imwejjed, is-siġġijiet u s-sodod.
Id-dar u l-familja; l-unità domestika.

usage_examples.mt: Ixtraw għamara ġdida għall-kamra tal-ikel.
usage_examples.en: They bought new furniture for the dining room.

usage_examples.mt: L-għamara antika kienet tiswa ħafna flus.
usage_examples.en: The antique furniture was worth a lot of money.

definitions.text_mt: Iwettaq azzjoni jew joħloq xi ħaġa.
Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.
Iseħħ; isir.
Jirranġa jew jippjana avveniment.
Iqatta' l-ħin b'ċertu mod.
Joħroġ l-ilma minn toqba; inixxi.
Jagħti spettaklu jew wirja quddiem udjenza.

definitions.text_en: to play (act in a performance) [with -ha ‘dummy object’ and ta’]
definitions.text_mt: Jirreċta parti f'dramm jew spettaklu.
Iħobb xi ħaġa bil-kbir u japprezzaha ħafna.
Iqiegħed xi ħaġa f'postha.
Jipproduċi l-frott (għal siġra).
Jaħdem l-art; jikkoltiva.
Ixarrab bl-ilma b'mod sħiħ.
Iqis; jaħseb li xi ħaġa hija minnha.

definitions.text_en: to do (something) [with ma’ or għal ‘for someone’]
definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd jew għal xi ħadd.
Jaqa' taħt kategorija partikolari.
Jattakka b'mod aggressiv.
Jixbah u jimita l-imġiba ta' xi ħadd.

definitions.text_en: to do a favour or wrong [with lil]
definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel ġid jew deni lil xi ħadd.
Jagħmel li jrid; jippretendi.
Jirnexxi jasal jew itemm xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Għamel il-ħobż biż-żebbuġ u r-rum.
usage_examples.en: He made bread with olives and pomegranate.

usage_examples.mt: X'għamilt ilbieraħ filgħaxija?
usage_examples.en: What did you do yesterday evening?

usage_examples.mt: Ġara inċident u ma għamilx ħsara.
usage_examples.en: There was an accident and no harm was done.

definitions.text_en: to dip (to lower into a liquid)
definitions.text_mt: Jgħaddas xi ħaġa f'likwidu; ibaxxi ġo likwidu.

usage_examples.mt: Ġhamset il-ħobż fil-ħalib qabel ma kilitu.
usage_examples.en: She dipped the bread in the milk before eating it.

usage_examples.mt: Għames il-pinzell fiż-żebgħa blu.
usage_examples.en: He dipped the brush in the blue paint.

definitions.text_mt: Kitba oħra ta' għemeż; jagħlaq u jiftaħ għajnu malajr bħala sinjal.

usage_examples.mt: Għamżetlu b'għajnejha biex turih li kienet taf.
usage_examples.en: She winked at him to show that she knew.

usage_examples.mt: Għameżli meta għadd ejt minn ħdejh.
usage_examples.en: He winked at me when I passed by him.

definitions.text_mt: Il-fond; dak li jinsab taħt il-wiċċ b'mod qawwi.
L-iktar parti fil-fond ta' xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: L-għamieq tal-baħar huwa mimli kreaturi strambi.
usage_examples.en: The depth of the sea is full of strange creatures.

usage_examples.mt: Ma jaf ħadd x'jinsab fl-għamieq tal-art.
usage_examples.en: No one knows what lies in the depths of the earth.

definitions.text_mt: Il-mod kif issir xi ħaġa; id-dehra jew il-forma ta' xi ħaġa.
Il- qagħda jew it-tip ta' xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nħobbx l-għamla kif għamilt dan ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: I do not like the way you did this work.

usage_examples.mt: X'għamla ta' siġra hija din?
usage_examples.en: What kind of tree is this?

usage_examples.mt: Il-mejda kellha għamla tonda sabiħa.
usage_examples.en: The table had a beautiful round shape.

definitions.text_mt: Ħu l-missier; ziju min-naħa ta' missieru.

usage_examples.mt: L-għamm kien raġel ġentili u maħbub minn kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: The paternal uncle was a kind man loved by everyone.

usage_examples.mt: Żar lil għammu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: He visited his paternal uncle at the weekend.

definitions.text_mt: Iqiegħed għamad fuq għajnejn xi ħadd biex ma jara xejn.

usage_examples.mt: Għammaduh qabel ma ħaduh biex ma jarax fejn kien sejjer.
usage_examples.en: They blindfolded him before taking him so he would not see where he was going.

definitions.text_mt: Jgħix f'post; jirrisjedi b'mod permanenti.
Iżżejjen jew jarma dar bil-għamara u t-tagħmir meħtieġ.
Irabbijiet l-annimali; iżomm u jkabbar l-annimali.

usage_examples.mt: Għammar f'dik il-belt għal ħafna snin qabel mar l-Amerika.
usage_examples.en: He lived in that city for many years before going to America.

usage_examples.mt: Għammru d-dar il-ġdida bl-ifjen għamara.
usage_examples.en: They furnished the new house with the finest furniture.

usage_examples.mt: Jgħammar in-naħal għall-għasel.
usage_examples.en: He breeds bees for honey.

definitions.text_mt: Jagħmel il-magħmudija; jdaħħal fil-fidi Nisranija permezz tal-ilma.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qassis għammed it-tarbija fil-knisja l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
usage_examples.en: The priest baptised the baby in the church last week.

usage_examples.mt: Għammduh meta kellu biss xahar.
usage_examples.en: He was baptised when he was only a month old.

definitions.text_en: to dip (to lower into a liquid)
definitions.text_mt: Jgħaddas xi ħaġa f'likwidu; ibaxxi ġo likwidu b'mod qawwi.

usage_examples.mt: Għammes il-kejk fil-ġulepp u ħallieh għal ftit minuti.
usage_examples.en: He dipped the cake in the syrup and left it for a few minutes.

usage_examples.mt: Għammes subgħajh fl-ilma biex iħoss kemm kien sħun.
usage_examples.en: He dipped his finger in the water to feel how hot it was.
